name: continuous-small
intent: Approved continuous small head motion: original meow-v2 artwork, grounded paws, 460 ms ascent/descent, no peak hold. Adjacent endpoint-corrected dense RIFE poses blend in premultiplied RGBA and bake to a 240 Hz timeline; no runtime renderer change. Cache reuse is optional and content-verified; missing cache is regenerated from the original v2 source artwork.
